items.title: “Every Run Is a Race Run” | Vital's B Practice Podcast - South Korea World Cup
items.description:
After a rough first race of the year, followed by some horrendous travel, it took us an extra week to nail down our guy Dak to podcast. We chatted a good bit about his race weekend in South Korea and how he’s feeling about his program going into the next big block of racing. We also discussed how he rushed to race the Monster Pro Downhill at Mountain Creek last weekend, and how he’s heading to Andorra next week to make his bike stiffer. Plus, all the usual race weekend coverage, including Asa winning his first try in Elites, Aletha having the fastest time of the day, track notes from a wild first-time venue, gripes with the broadcast, Amaury’s what could have been winning run, big names off the pace, new names in juniors, and a bunch of other nonsense. We hope you enjoy. Thanks for listening!

items.title: Charlie Murray | Why I’m Stepping Away From The Enduro World Cup
items.description:
Why would a top Enduro rider step away from the World Cup?

In this episode of the Downtime Podcast, we sit down with Charlie Murray to understand why he’s made the decision to step back from a full UCI Enduro World Cup campaign and rethink his future in the sport.

After years competing at the highest level, Charlie explains how racing began to shift from something exciting into something that felt like an obligation. Combined with the demands of the calendar, changes in team support, and the realities of making a living in professional mountain biking, it led him to reassess what he actually wants moving forward.

Rather than walking away completely, Charlie is choosing a different path. Racing on his own terms, focusing on the events and projects that genuinely excite him, and building a more sustainable setup outside of the traditional system.

This conversation also touches on the wider picture, including how brands are reassessing their investment in enduro, and what that means for riders across the sport.
